Data Privacy Notice
Last updated November 17, 2026

Daily Reminder respects your privacy. This notice explains what information the app processes, why, and what your rights are under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173), its Implementing Rules and Regulations, and the issuances of the National Privacy Commission (NPC).

1. Who we are
Daily Reminder was developed by Group LIBRAS as a school project. For questions about this notice or your data, contact any of us:
• cbaldonado.k12256165@umak.edu.ph
• enecesario.k12255958@umak.edu.ph
• arosalan.k12255842@umak.edu.ph
• bsaavedra.k12257228@umak.edu.ph
• murdaneta.k12256252@umak.edu.ph

2. What information the app processes
• The reminders you create: title, description, time, repeat days, snooze length, notification sound, and whether a reminder is marked completed.
• The date and time you agreed to this notice (your consent record).
The app does not ask for your name, phone number, email, location, contacts, photos or any account. Please avoid typing sensitive personal information (such as health conditions or ID numbers) in your reminders. If you do, it is protected in the same way as all other reminder data.

3. Why the information is processed
Only to save your reminders, show them to you, and notify you at the times you choose. It is not used for advertising, profiling, or any other purpose.

4. Legal basis
Your consent, under Section 12(a) of RA 10173. You give it by ticking the consent box when you first open the app. Giving consent is your free choice, and you may withdraw it at any time.

5. Where your information is kept and who can see it
Your reminders are stored only on this phone, in the app’s private storage, and the titles and descriptions are encrypted (AES-256). The app has no internet permission, so the developers never receive or see your data, and it is not shared with, sold to, or transferred to anyone. It is also excluded from cloud backups.

6. How long it is kept
Until you delete the reminder, withdraw your consent, or uninstall the app. Uninstalling removes all reminder data and the encryption key.

7. How your information is protected
Encryption with a key kept in the Android Keystore, app-private storage, no cloud backups, and the phone’s screen lock (PIN, pattern or fingerprint) is required before your reminders are shown.

8. Your rights as a data subject
Under RA 10173 you have the right to:
• be informed about how your data is processed (this notice);
• access your data: all of it is shown on the main screen;
• correct it: tap a reminder to edit it;
• object and withdraw consent, and to have your data erased or blocked: delete a reminder with the trash icon, or use Menu → Withdraw consent and delete all data;
• data portability: your reminders are shown in full in the app and can be copied by you;
• damages if you are harmed by a violation of your data privacy rights; and
• file a complaint with the National Privacy Commission (www.privacy.gov.ph).

9. Phone permissions
Android will separately ask you to allow notifications and exact alarms. These are used only to deliver your reminders. You may refuse them, but reminders may then not appear or may be late.

10. Changes to this notice
If this notice changes, the app will show it again and ask for your consent before you continue.

If you are below 18 years old, please read this notice with your parent or guardian.

Terms of Use

1. Daily Reminder is a free school project provided “as is”, for personal use only.

2. Reminders depend on your phone’s settings (battery saver, Do Not Disturb, notification and alarm permissions). We cannot guarantee that every reminder will appear on time, so do not rely on the app alone for medical, safety, or other critical reminders.

3. You are responsible for what you write in your reminders and must use the app lawfully.

4. To the extent allowed by law, the developers are not liable for missed reminders or for data lost when the app is uninstalled or its data is cleared.

5. These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines.
